claims: [P1] Pull-request write access isn't verified (`codex-cloud-setup.sh:184-185`): the GET on the pulls endpoint only needs read access, so it can't show that the token can write
If the repo is public, both GETs succeed for any valid token, so they add nothing beyond `gh auth status`

Pre-push hooks run during the write probe (`:205-206`): real, but only on re-runs, if someone re-runs setup by hand in an already-configured checkout; add `--no-verify` to both probe pushes (`:199`, `:206`, `:217`)
Maintenance doesn't refresh Chromium (`:583`): someone running `test:browser` directly on a branch that bumps `@playwright/test`, outside the gate, would hit a missing browser
Setup now aborts when `origin` isn't a GitHub URL (`codex-cloud-setup.sh:556-557`): the two new checks don't skip non-GitHub origins; `gh repo view` (`:179`) fails and `set -e` stops setup

Any failed probe push is reported as a token-permission problem (`:206-213`): the message blames Contents permission, but hooks, a ruleset blocking branch creation, or a network error produce the same message
The probe pushes `HEAD` before `ensure_origin_main_ref`, so git may have to upload objects, which can fail on a shallow clone (guess, unconfirmed)
The new Playwright step fails setup while the other setup scripts only warn (`:537`): any new Codex environment whose network policy lacks the Playwright or apt hosts now fails setup
The outbound-access list in the docs is incomplete (`docs/notes/codex-cloud-setup.md:61-70`): `--with-deps` and the GitHub CLI fallback need the distro's apt mirrors, which the list doesn't mention
Test gaps (`codex-cloud-setup.test.sh`): no test covers the branch where the probe branch is created but can't be deleted (`:217-221`)
Vercel: a push to any branch may create a Vercel preview deployment record, so every setup run may leave one behind (unconfirmed)

judge_reasoning.3846756487: Review claim 1 says the GET on the pulls endpoint only needs read access, so it cannot show the token can write to pull requests. That is the same defect.
judge_reasoning.3846756810: Review finding A says verify_origin_git_auth skips non-GitHub origins but the two new checks (gh repo view, etc.) lack the same guard, so setup aborts. That is the same defect.
judge_reasoning.3846756918: No match. The review explicitly clears the created flag logic as correct after a failed delete, the opposite of this defect.
judge_reasoning.3846756922: No match. The review explicitly says $$ plus a timestamp is unique enough for the branch name.
judge_reasoning.3846757143: No match. The review never suggests git push --dry-run and never flags the create/delete mutation of origin as the problem. Its Vercel note is a different side effect.
judge_reasoning.3846757191: Review finding D says the docs' outbound-access list lacks the distro apt mirrors needed by --with-deps. That is the same defect.

1.why: Lines 184-185 only do a GET on repos/{repo}/pulls. The known item about verifying PR write access at :195 already covers this.

2.why: This is a design remark about how much the GETs at :182/:185 add over gh auth status, not a concrete defect. The PR-write overlap is already a known item.

3.why: core.hooksPath .trunk/hooks is set only after the probe (:559-560) and persists in the checkout. On a re-run, both git pushes at :206 and :217 fire .trunk/hooks/pre-push (trunk) without --no-verify.

4.why: codex-cloud-maintenance.sh was not changed and has no Playwright step. This is a hypothetical about running outside the gate, not a defect introduced by this diff.

5.why: Line 179 runs gh repo view with no non-GitHub skip, unlike verify_origin_git_auth at :158-161. That is exactly the known :179 consistency item.

6.why: At :206-213, any non-zero exit from git push (hook, ruleset, network) prints the same message blaming Contents read/write permission.

7.why: Admitted guess. HEAD in a fresh Codex checkout comes from origin, so no object upload is shown, and the ordering relative to ensure_origin_main_ref doesn't affect the push.

8.why: Other setup steps fail closed too: install_trunk_tools, install_foundry and check_osv_api_egress all return 1 under set -e, and the docs say setup fails closed. They don't just warn.

9.why: Missing distro apt sources in the outbound-access list matches the known docs item 'Document the distribution package source' (codex-cloud-setup.md:70).

10.why: The new test cases only cover playwright-host-dependencies(-disabled) and origin-write-access(-refused). Nothing exercises verify_github_api_capabilities.

11.why: The refused test's git stub fails the first push, and the success test succeeds on both pushes. No case has create succeed and delete fail (:217-221).

12.why: vercel.json deploymentEnabled only excludes sentry-autofix/*, so probe branches can trigger deployments. That is a side effect of the known P3 item that the probe mutates origin on every setup run.
